reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, and I have a bottle that costs me a lot less per day. Sachets to take on the go solve a problem I don't have.
objection: I don't need it to go. I'm home every evening, so I'd be paying extra for the sachet packaging when a bottle does the same job for cheaper.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to what I pay now for a bottle, around $15 for 30 days, or a free first box so I can try it without risk.
